Cover art for "The Schmoozer" - 7/13/2026
The glorious Schmoozer. This was originally going be a solo art, but the hands were too hard. I eventually figured it out and made it the single's cover art.
Visit my Bandcamp to see it in action...
This is one of many forehead creatures I like to draw. It's easy to do make the face, but the creatures can all be uniquely weird. Inspired by Avery Palmer most likely.


Jet & Lich - 6/29/2026
A whole folder in the Blog, Jet and Lich are associated with a big comic I've always wanted to make. I've never drawn
the Lich, and this is my second time drawing Jet besides the crappy prototype comic on DA. Jet's artstyle was originally
big oval eyes that clipped past his head, but I realized that wouldn't make much sense. I haven't drawn the comic
because I'm sick of drawing...this took a few hours, and probably wasn't worth it... Lich's scythe looks cool, though.
Jet and Lich are both very dark-colored characters, so it was a challenge to make them work. There's a chance
Jet looks edgy because of all his dark, but he's no match for Lich. Jet is partially supposed to look edgy because
he actually isn't edgy at all. The characters' signatures are on the top. Jet writes Roman letters, and Lich writes his species' letters...

Uncommon Ass - 9/26/2025
A random thing I made with Libresprite. I'm like pixel art better than normal art because it's easier to manipulate. Even
Big things like J&L or Furghi Manga are made with a pixel brush. In the end, all digital art is just pixels no matter how it's drawn.
Go with the flow...
The only time I've gotten a fan message was for Lix2 (or was it the first Lix?) later on in the gallery.

Furghi Manga 2 - Page 7 - 4/14/2024
This was the highest-effort thing I made up until Jet & Lich, so over two years. Both of the reaction panels were supposed to show outside of
the window Verv and Qo were in, but I got lazy and made it a dramatic fog. The other Furghi Mangas were made before I actually read any sort of
manga. When I made this, I had been reading either Crows, Fist of the North Star, or A-Bout and knew how to format a comic properly.
In this page, Verv and Qo have been picked up by a mysterious guy who wants to give them a job.
Visit my Pixiv to see other versions including the original colored version, and the blog to see other ideas for Furghi Manga.
